## Release v10.11 - [Extended Support Release](https://docs.mattermost.com/product-overview/release-policy.html#release-types) \{#release-v10-11-extended-support-release}

<Attention>

**Known Issue**
 - Customers should not upgrade from ``>=10.11.17`` to ``<=11.7.2`` due to a bug that causes an issue with database migration numbers. The bug is fixed in v11.7.3.

</Attention>

- **10.11.24, released 2026-09-16**
  - Mattermost v10.11.24 contains a High severity level security fix. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended. Details will be posted on our [security updates page](https://mattermost.com/security-updates/) 30 days after release as per the [Mattermost Responsible Disclosure Policy](https://mattermost.com/security-vulnerability-report/).
  - Added signing and verification of the SAML ``RelayState`` value so that modifications made to it after it leaves the server are detected and rejected.
  - Mattermost v10.11.24 contains no database schema changes.
